source: Morris et al., Eng. Fract. Mech. 310 (2024) 110421, Figs 3, 4, 9 (graphical read-off by the orchestrator; exact per-specimen data are on PURR doi:10.4231/ZX5A-QJ30 behind Globus and were not obtained)

peak_load.verdict: under-predicted by roughly 9 % (5-12 % allowing for read-off error); below all four expert teams

stiffness.verdict: consistent with the measured slope; the measured curves stiffen with load, which the contact law reproduces only on average

crack_path.verdict: start positions and front exit within about 1 mm; back exit about 2 mm off and just outside the stated range; predicted one exit position for both faces whereas the measured faces differ by about 2 mm

not_graded: organisers' area-based error metrics (need the digital experimental envelope); displacement fields and roughness were not predicted
